FX-ELLIPSE-001.says: The settings as they start: centre in the middle, 200 by 200, thickness 8, softness 50, white inside, blue outside, composited: the outline lies far outside the small frame, the cel as it was.

FX-ELLIPSE-002.says: 12 by 8, thickness 2, softness 0: a sharp outline 2 pixels thick round the middle over the cel, white along its middle, blue at its edges.

FX-ELLIPSE-003.says: FX-ELLIPSE-002 with Composite On Original off: the outline alone, the rest clear.

FX-ELLIPSE-004.says: FX-ELLIPSE-003 at softness 100: the whole width of the outline ramps.

FX-ELLIPSE-005.says: 10 by 10, thickness 2, alone: a circle of radius 5, the distance exact.

FX-ELLIPSE-007.says: Orange inside, violet outside, thickness 4, alone: orange along the middle, violet at the edges.

FX-ELLIPSE-008.says: Thickness 0: nothing drawn, the cel as it was.

FX-ELLIPSE-009.says: 8 by 6 alone, the centre keyed from (50, 50) at frame 0 to (25, 50) at frame 4, linear: the outline slides left, 1 pixel a frame.

FX-ELLIPSE-010.says: Width keyed from 8 at frame 0 to 16 at frame 4, linear, alone: frame 2 is 12 across.

FX-ELLIPSE-011.says: FX-ELLIPSE-002 moved three pixels right: the outline moves with the layer.

FX-ELLIPSE-012.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the centre is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-ELLIPSE-002's.

FX-ELLIPSE-013.says: FX-ELLIPSE-007 with its colours in capitals, #FF8000 and #6450A0: the same.

FX-ELLIPSE-014.says: 20 by 10, the centre at (-25, 50) per cent, outside the drawing, alone: the outline's right end, at x 6, reaches into the frame's left side.

FX-ELLIPSE-015.says: Thickness keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 past its end by an ease: held at 0, frame 4 the cel as it was.

FX-ELLIPSE-016.says: 4 by 10, tall, alone: the outline narrow across, long down.

FX-ELLIPSE-017.says: Thickness 1, softness 0, alone: a hairline, each pixel covered by how much of it lies within half a pixel of the outline.

FX-ELLIPSE-018.says: Width 1, height 1, thickness 2, alone: a dot at the middle.

FX-ELLIPSE-019.says: Width 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-020.says: Height 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-021.says: Thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-022.says: Softness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-023.says: Centre 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-024.says: Composite "yes", not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-025.says: Inside colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-026.says: Outside colour "red", not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ELLIPSE-027.says: Width keyed to 10001 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
